title: Promotion of Bladder Cancer Cell Metastasis by 2-Mercaptobenzothiazole via Its Activation of Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor Transcription: Molecular Dynamics Simulations, Cell-Based Assays, and Machine Learning-Driven Prediction.
authors: Zhang, Jiachen; Cui, Shixuan; Shen, Lilai; Gao, Yuchen; Liu, Weiping; Zhang, Chunlong; Zhuang, Shulin
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟和机器学习研究MBT激活AhR转录因子促进膀胱癌转移，虽涉及TF-DNA转录激活但核心是毒理学致癌机制，非TF-DNA结合互作建模，方法可借鉴但对象偏离。
abstract: 2-Mercaptobenzothiazole (MBT) is an industrial chemical widely used for rubber products, corrosion inhibitors, and polymer materials with multiple environmental and exposure pathways. A growing body of evidence suggests its potential bladder cancer (BC) risk as a public health concern; however, the molecular mechanism remains poorly understood. Herein, we demonstrate the activation of the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) by MBT and reveal key events in carcinogenesis associated with BC. MBT alters conformational changes of AhR ligand binding domain (LBD) as revealed by 500 ns molecular dynamics simulations and activates AhR transcription with upregulation of AhR-target genes CYP1A1 and CYP1B1 to approximately 1.5-fold. MBT upregulates the expression of MMP1, the cancer cell metastasis biomarker, to 3.2-fold and promotes BC cell invasion through an AhR-mediated manner. MBT is further revealed to induce differentially expressed genes (DEGs) most enriched in cancer pathways by transcriptome profiling. The exposure of MBT at environmentally relevant concentrations induces BC risk via AhR signaling disruption, transcriptome aberration, and malignant cell metastasis. A machine learning-based model with an AUC value of 0.881 is constructed to successfully predict 31 MBT analogues. Overall, we provide molecular insight into the BC risk of MBT and develop an effective tool for rapid screening of AhR agonists.
abstract_zh: 2-巯基苯并噻唑（MBT）是一种广泛用于橡胶制品、腐蚀抑制剂和聚合物材料的工业化学品，具有多种环境和暴露途径。越来越多的证据表明，其潜在的膀胱癌（BC）风险是一个公共卫生问题；然而，其分子机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们证明了MBT对芳烃受体（AhR）的激活，并揭示了与BC相关的致癌关键事件。通过500 ns分子动力学模拟，MBT改变了AhR配体结合域（LBD）的构象变化，并激活AhR转录，使AhR靶基因CYP1A1和CYP1B1上调约1.5倍。MBT将癌细胞转移生物标志物MMP1的表达上调至3.2倍，并通过AhR介导的方式促进BC细胞侵袭。进一步通过转录组谱分析揭示，MBT诱导的差异表达基因（DEGs）最富集于癌症通路。在环境相关浓度下暴露MBT，通过AhR信号干扰、转录组异常和恶性细胞转移诱导BC风险。构建了基于机器学习且AUC值为0.881的模型，成功预测了31种MBT类似物。总体而言，我们提供了MBT对BC风险的分子见解，并开发了一种快速筛选AhR激动剂的有效工具。
